claim_limits: Capability formalization with known prior real-data outcome; not a new outcome-blind falsification experiment.
Conditional Newman et al. 2014 reporting-consistency representation only.
No raw-data or full torsion-pendulum estimator reproduction.
No inference that the authors used a particular nearest-rounding tie convention.
Closed terminal bins are conservative consistency domains, not claims about exact historical rounding behavior.
Compatible means at least one frozen strict-interior scheduled representation exists in the joint reporting interval.
Incompatible is model-relative and means the declared reporting constraints cannot be jointly represented by the declared component model.
Unresolved remains schedule-relative and also covers boundary-only/degenerate joint terminal cases.
No hidden unrounded values, unique printed cell, discrepancy cause, probability model, p-value, likelihood, or sampling frequency is inferred.
No comparison of measured central G values, universality claim, cross-measurement estimator, or PR #41 joint-object update.
No E-001 artifact is an input or dependency.
Effective terminal width and narrowing ratio must be reported explicitly so the certificate's resolution ceiling is quotable.

classification.invalid: Malformed, missing, or provenance-invalid evidence raises and never becomes a numerical verdict.

component_model.central_value_invariance: q_1 = 1; any positive central schema value cancels

epistemic_routing.DM-053_DM-056: Frozen historical artifacts are not rewritten. The new artifact must state its effective terminal width explicitly.
epistemic_routing.DM-055: The PR #42 result certificate is preservation-only and is not an input; this PR recomputes from the frozen source projection and schedule rather than consuming the old verdict artifact.
epistemic_routing.DM-057_FH-3: New candidate generation must receive component half-width alone, never a full terminal-bearing rounding-policy object.
epistemic_routing.E-001: Structurally outside this PR: no HUST disputed artifact may be imported, read, preserved, or claimed through.
epistemic_routing.FH-2: The PR #42 3375-point schedule is retained unchanged; no retrofit of older frozen certificates.
epistemic_routing.FH-6: This PR is the prospective implementation of multi-resolution terminal constraints.

known_prior_information.allowed_claim: This PR may establish a reproducible capability and exact certificate, but must not present the real-data verdict as newly discovered or prospectively blind.
known_prior_information.reason: Claude's PR #42 audit predates this freeze and already reported that all three real fibres remain compatible under the integer-plus-one-decimal terminal constraints, with fibre 1 narrowed.

objective: Formalize exact multi-resolution terminal-constraint intersection for the established Newman 2014 fibre uncertainty model.

reporting_model.degenerate_joint_interval: unresolved unless the component enclosure is already disjoint
reporting_model.joint_interval: max of lows through min of highs
reporting_model.strict_compatible_witness: component interiors and strict interior of a nondegenerate joint terminal squared interval

resolution_reporting.claim_limit: Compatible establishes existence under the declared reporting model; it does not establish a unique printed cell, hidden author values, or historical rounding procedure.

known_prior_auditor_information.epistemic_effect: This PR is capability formalization with a known expected real-data outcome, not an outcome-blind falsification experiment.
known_prior_auditor_information.observation: The auditor already checked that the integer statements would leave all three real verdicts compatible and would narrow fibre 1's terminal domain.
